text: Berlin's World Clock carries a ring of 24 time zones that turns through the day. Laid over the 26 letters it gives a shift that grows by one, now and then two.
Every way of laying the ring over the letters, turning one zone per letter or more slowly, from every start, with a secret word of 1-24 letters on 12 table rules.
Nothing fits K4 or any of 20 scrambled copies; a planted text is found. F3.6 closed.
